full_prompt_en: A square daylight architectural photograph shows a two-story facade whose flowing green metalwork surrounds tall brown windows and a recessed central entrance. The building occupies nearly the whole width of the selected panel, viewed directly from across a quiet paved street. At the top, a broad oxidized green cornice rises into a rounded central crest and curls down at both sides in smooth organic waves. Beneath it, a tall central upper window has a rounded top and narrow vertical panes. Two wider window bays flank it, each framed by green ribs that bend around the openings like stems. At street level, paired dark windows and an arched central doorway sit behind further curving supports. Warm interior light glows through the entrance, while the other glass reflects the pale sky and adjacent structures. Gray stone blocks fill the spaces between metal and windows, their straight joints contrasting with the sinuous green frame. Slender neighboring buildings press close on both sides, and a leafy tree intrudes from the upper-right corner. A short stretch of empty gray pavement and curb runs along the bottom edge. The viewpoint is level and frontal, emphasizing the near symmetry of the facade even though the metal curves vary from side to side. Soft overcast daylight from above reveals the green patina, stone grain, and reddish-brown window frames without hard shadows. The overall composition treats the facade as one sculptural surface, balancing regular window rhythm with fluid botanical-looking lines.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形日光建筑照片呈现一座两层立面，流动的绿色金属结构围着高高的棕色窗户和内凹的中央入口。所选单图中建筑几乎占满宽度，视点从安静的铺砖街对面正面望去。顶部宽阔的氧化绿檐口在中央升成圆拱形高点，向两侧以平滑的有机波形下卷。其下中央上层高窗顶部圆弧，窗格细长竖直。两侧更宽的窗区由弯曲的绿肋包围，像茎线般围绕开口。街面层有成对深色窗和拱形中央门洞，前方还有弯曲支撑。入口内暖光发亮，其余玻璃映着浅色天空和邻近结构。灰石块填满金属与窗之间的空隙，笔直的砌缝对照蜿蜒绿色框架。两侧相邻建筑贴得很近，右上角有一棵叶树伸入。底缘是一小段空旷灰色路面和路缘。视点平齐且正面，强调立面近乎对称，尽管金属曲线左右并不完全一样。柔和阴天光从上方照来，显出绿锈、石纹和红棕窗框，没有硬影。整体构图把立面视作单一雕塑表面，以规律的窗节奏平衡流动的植物状线条。
style_prompt_en: Daylight photography records oxidized green metal, gray stone, reddish wood, and transparent glass with clear material separation. Curved ribs and elongated arcs flow around repeated vertical openings, so organic line and regular grid remain in dialogue. Fine patina, stone joints, and subtle reflections give surfaces tactile specificity without heavy contrast. Soft overcast illumination is even from above, preserving detail in recesses while gentle interior warmth punctuates a cooler exterior palette. A centered frontal viewpoint makes broad symmetry legible, then lets small irregular curves become the interest. The transferable visual mechanism is a balance of sinuous structure, straight rhythm, translucent depth, and restrained patinated color. The overall effect is elegant, organic, and quietly sculptural.
style_prompt_zh: 日光摄影把氧化绿色金属、灰石、红棕木材与透明玻璃拍出清楚的材质差别。弯曲肋线和修长弧线绕着重复的竖向开口流动，使有机线条与规则格网形成对话。细绿锈、石缝与微弱反光赋予表面可触的具体性，没有沉重反差。柔和阴天光从上方均匀照来，保留凹处细节，微弱室内暖色则点破较冷的外部色盘。居中正面视点先让宽泛对称容易辨认，再让细小的不规则弯线成为兴趣所在。可迁移的视觉机制是蜿蜒结构、笔直节奏、透光纵深和克制旧绿色之间的平衡。整体效果优雅、有机且安静地富于雕塑感。
theme_en: An Art Nouveau facade with flowing green metal around brown windows
theme_zh: 一座新艺术风格立面以流动的绿色金属围住棕色窗户
name: Hector Guimard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
